Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

Creamy Cajun Chicken 🔥 Ingredients For the chicken: * Chicken breasts * Salt * Black pepper * Garlic powder * Cajun seasoning For the Cajun sauce: * Butter * Chopped onion * Cherry tomatoes * Red bell pepper * Minced garlic * Tomato paste * Salt & black pepper * Thyme * Oregano * Cajun seasoning * Chicken broth * Heavy cream Cooking Instructions 1. Season the chicken: Pat the chicken breasts dry and season both sides with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and Cajun seasoning. 2. Cook the chicken: Heat a little oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken on both sides until golden brown and fully cooked (165°F internal temperature). Remove from the skillet and set aside. 3. Prepare the sauce: In the same skillet, melt the butter. Add the chopped onion, red bell pepper and cherry tomatoes. Sauté until softened. 4. Add the aromatics: Stir in the minced garlic and tomato paste. Cook for about 1 minute. 5. Season the sauce: Add salt, black pepper, thyme, oregano and Cajun seasoning. Stir everything together. 6. Make it creamy: Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream. Stir well and let the sauce simmer until it thickens slightly. 7. Bring it all together: Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the creamy Cajun sauce over the chicken. Let everything simmer together for a few minutes so the flavors come together. 8. Serve: Garnish with fresh parsley if desired. Serve warm over rice, mashed potatoes, or pasta. 🤍 Enjoy your Creamy Cajun Chicken! #CreamyCajunChicken #CajunCooking #ChickenRecipes  #creatorsearchinsights #recipestocook

Cream garlic parmesan chicken melt. For the creamy chicken filling : 2 tbsp butter  1/2 cup yellow onion, finely chopped  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced  2 cup rotisserie chicken , shredded  Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  1 tsp paprika powder  1 tsp red chili flakes 1/4 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream  5 tbsp cream cheese  1/4 cup green onion, chopped  1/4 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tbsp parsley, chopped  To assemble  6 sliced bread of choice  1 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded  Butter for toasting  Method: Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken, garlic powder, black pepper, paprika and chili flakes. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes so the seasonings coat the chicken. Lower the heat. Add the cream cheese and heavy cream, stirring until smooth and combined. Fold in the Parmesan. If the mixture is too thick, add heavy cream a teaspoon at a time. Stir in the green onion and parsley. Taste before adding salt. The mixture should be creamy and thick, not runny. Butter the outside of each bread slice. On the inside, layer mozzarella, a generous amount of creamy chicken, more mozzarella and the second slice of bread. Divide the filling and cheese evenly among three sandwiches. Cook over medium-low heat for about 3–4 minutes per side, until the bread is deeply golden and crisp and the cheese has melted. Cover the pan briefly if needed to help the center melt, then uncover to keep the crust crisp. Let each sandwich rest for about a minute before slicing and enjoy. #recipe #garlicparmesan #sandwich #cheese

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

pumpkin cinnamon roll cookies dough: 1 cup (226g) unsalted butter, softened 1/2 cup (100g) white sugar 1/2 cup packed (100g) light brown sugar 1 whole egg + 2 yolks 1 tsp (4g) vanilla extract 1/2 cup (120g) pumpkin puree 3 cups (375g) ap flour 3/4 tsp (4g) baking soda 1/2 tsp (3g) salt 4 tsp pumpkin spice  *cream together the butter and sugars well then add in the eggs, vanilla, extract, and pumpkin puree. important: press the pumpkin puree between a couple layers of paper towel to get rid of the moisture! in another bowl, whisk the flour, baking soda, salt, and pumpkin spice. pour the dry into the wet and fold to mix. using some plastic wrap or parchment paper. spread the dough evenly. if its too soft and sticky, then set it in the fridge for 30-45 min to firm up a bit. once all flat and even in a large rectangle. spread on the swirl paste (recipe below) as even possible but leaving abut an inch or two on the top. carefully roll into a tight log then set in the fridge at least an hour so that it holds it shape. slice into even pieces and bake at 350 for 12-14 min (time will vary on the size). let cool completely before glazing! swirl paste: 3 tbsp (40g) light brown sugar 1 tbsp (14g) unsalted butter, melted 2 tsp (5g) cinnamon 1/2 tsp (2g) pumpkin spice blend 1/2 tsp (2g) cornstarch pinch of salt *combine everything into a paste and spread on the rectangle flat dough sheet.  vanilla glaze: 1 cup (120g) powdered sugar 1-2 tbsp (15-20g) milk, cream, or water 1/2 tsp (2g) vanilla pinch of salt *mix all together and adjust the consistency with either more powdered sugar or more liquid. brush evenly on the cooled cookies :) #pumpkin #cinnamonroll #cookies #recipe

This Pepper Steak is a simple recipe that can made in under 1 hour for a weeknight dinner. Full recipe is posted below and on my blog (check bio) My cookbook, Let’s Get Into It, is currently on sale at its lowest price on Amazon!  Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Artist Casey Curran creates kinetic sculptures that combine mechanical systems with forms inspired by plants and natural structures. In this prototype, layers of delicate petals are connected so that a single mechanical action produces a rippling movement across the entire structure. Instead of every element moving independently, the motion travels through the sculpture like a wave. This type of movement is central to Curran’s practice. Using motors, wires, cranks and carefully engineered mechanisms, he creates artificial flowers and organisms that bloom, flutter and contract.  The machinery is artificial, but the movement feels strangely organic ,engineering becomes a way of imitating the rhythms of living systems. #art #artist #fashion #avantgarde #design

COWBOY BUTTER CHICKEN ALFREDO 🤠🧈🍝  If you know me, you know I LOVE anything cowboy butter! This was a 10/10!! Creamy, cheesy, packed with SO much flavor, and ready in under 30 minutes!  INGREDIENTS: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cubed * 12 oz pasta * 1 tbsp olive oil @getgraza  *4 tbsp butter * 1½ cups heavy whipping cream (+ a splash more if needed) * 1 cup mozzarella cheese * ½ cup parmesan cheese * ½ cup pepper jack cheese * 1 tbsp Dijon mustard SEASONINGS (ALL TO TASTE): * Kinder’s Cowboy Butter Seasoning @Kinder's Flavors *Garlic powder * Onion powder * Italian seasoning * Paprika * Slap Ya Mama @Slap Ya Mama  * Salt & pepper INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. 2. Season cubed chicken with all seasonings. Cook in olive oil until golden and fully cooked (165°F).   3. Transfer chicken to a plate. Lower heat to medium-low and melt butter in the same skillet. Add the same seasonings and Dijon mustard. 4. Pour in heavy cream and simmer for 2–3 minutes. 5. Sprinkle in mozzarella, parmesan, and pepper jack. Stir until creamy, adding another splash of heavy cream if needed. 6. Add pasta and chicken back in, toss until coated, and serve! I didn’t measure my seasonings, just added everything to taste!  SAVE this easy chicken pasta recipe for your next weeknight dinner!! 🤍 #CowboyButterChicken #ChickenAlfredoRecipe #EasyDinnerIdeas #30MinuteMeals #ChickenPastaRecipes

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

Garlic Herb Butter Roasted Chicken Quarters with Potatoes & Carrots 🤤 recipe below & follow for more easy meal ideas! . An easy, cozy dinner that takes about 5 minutes to prep! Juicy, seasoned chicken quarters roasted over tender potatoes and carrots with garlic, fresh rosemary, and buttery herb goodness. Everything cooks together in one dish, and the best part? Almost no cleanup! This is the kind of dinner I love making for my family. ❤️ . Ingredients: -4 chicken leg quarters -1 pound Petite mini potatoes (enough to cover the bottom of your casserole dish) -4 carrots, cut into smaller pieces -1 tbsp minced garlic -Olive oil -Salt & pepper -Garlic powder -Onion powder -Paprika -Kinder’s Buttery Herb & Garlic seasoning -4 tbsp Kerrygold Garlic & Herb Butter, cut into 4 slices -2 sprigs fresh rosemary . 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Add mini potatoes and chopped carrots to a casserole dish. Add minced garlic, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Toss everything together. 3. In a large bowl, add chicken quarters and drizzle with olive oil. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Kinder’s Buttery Herb & Garlic seasoning. Toss until evenly coated. 4. Arrange chicken quarters over the potatoes and carrots. 5. Add additional seasoning on top if needed. Place one slice of garlic herb butter on each chicken quarter and tuck the rosemary sprigs around the chicken. 6. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30–35 minutes. 7. Remove foil and bake for another 30–35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F and the skin is golden and crispy. 8. Make sure the potatoes and carrots are fork-tender. Serve and enjoy! 🥰 . #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #foodtiktok #foodie #fyp @Le Creuset @Kinder's Flavors @Kerrygold USA

🍪 CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE SHOTS 🤎 Cute little chocolate chip cookie shots, perfect for filling with cold milk. Makes 9 cookie shots. Ingredients: • 1½ cups (227 g) all-purpose flour • ⅓ cup (65 g) packed brown sugar • 2 tbsp + 2 tsp (33 g) granulated sugar • ½ tsp baking powder • Pinch of salt • 6 tbsp (88 g) butter • 1 large egg • 1 tsp vanilla paste • ½ cup + 1 tbsp (100 g) mini semi-sweet chocolate chips For the chocolate coating: • 120 g milk chocolate, melted Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly grease the cookie shot mold and inserts. 2. Mix flour, sugars, baking powder, and salt. 3. Melt butter and let cool slightly. Whisk in egg and vanilla paste. 4. Combine wet and dry ingredients, then fold in chocolate chips. 5. Divide dough into 9 balls. Place into the mold and press inserts firmly down. 6. Bake for 17–19 minutes with inserts in place. 7. Trim the edges while warm. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then gently remove inserts and let cool completely. 8. Melt 120 g of milk chocolate and coat the inside of each cookie shot. Let the chocolate set completely, then fill with cold milk and enjoy🤎 #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #dessertrecipes #viralrecipes #christmasdesserts

Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. Sprinkle with fresh parsley if desired. Inspiration: @melissajorealrecipes 🧑‍🍳: @nicolemcmom #easydinners #dinnerideas #butter #chicken #chickenandrice

One Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken Bake🔥410 cals 37g protein 11g fat 40g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 ½ cups jasmine rice, uncooked 3 cups chicken broth, warmed 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 ½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 2 cups baby spinach, roughly chopped 4 cloves garlic, minced 50g freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 tsp Italian seasoning 1 ½ tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ¾ tsp smoked paprika ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) ¼ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F 2. Add chicken thigh, 1 ½ cups uncooked rice, diced onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, spinach, and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Season with 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ¾ tsp smoked paprika, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, and red pepper flakes if using. 4. Pour in 3 cups chicken broth and stir everything together until evenly combined and the rice is submerged. 5. Cover the baking dish tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes. 6. Remove the foil and add fresh parm and go back in the oven uncovered for another 15 mins at 400° 7. Finish with the remaining fresh parsley  Serve hot and enjoy! Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

An aquarium’s filter does far more than keep the water looking clean. It continuously removes waste, circulates oxygen, and provides a home for beneficial bacteria that break down harmful toxins produced by fish and uneaten food. Without proper filtration, ammonia and other toxic compounds can quickly build up, turning a healthy aquarium into a dangerous environment for its inhabitants. A good filtration system helps maintain water quality, stabilize the ecosystem, and keep fish healthy over the long term. While decorations and lighting may catch the eye, the filter is the unseen engine that keeps the entire aquarium alive.

Notice the GarlicDalek T did you? 😏😂 Follow the link in my bio for the link 💪❤️ HIGH PROTEIN HONEY GARLIC BUTTER CHICKEN MAC & CHEESE 9.5/10 — bloody lovely. 😂 Creamy, cheesy mac & cheese with sticky honey garlic chicken. Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

✨ Did you know you can make DIY taste-safe kinetic sand with simple ingredients from your pantry? It's non-toxic, budget-friendly, and perfect for toddlers! My 3-year-old often stays busy for an hour playing with it—molding shapes, digging treasures, and pretending to bake "cakes."  Ingredients You’ll Need: 1 cup baking soda 1/2 cup cornstarch 1/2 cup sugar 2–4 tablespoons warm water  (mix with food coloring of your choice) 1 tablespoon cream of tartar Step-by-Step Instructions: Mix the dry ingredients In a large mixing bowl, combine the baking soda, cornstarch, sugar, and cream of tartar. Stir until evenly distributed. Prepare the colored water In a small bowl, add a few drops of food coloring to the warm water. Adjust the intensity of the color by adding more or fewer drops. Combine wet and dry ingredients Gradually add the colored water to the dry mixture, 1 tablespoon at a time. Mix with a spoon or your hands until the sand reaches your desired consistency—moist and moldable, but not sticky. You may not need all the water, so add it slowly! Test and play Once the mixture holds its shape when squeezed, it’s ready for playtime! If it feels too dry, add a few drops of water. If it’s too sticky, sprinkle in a bit more cornstarch. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. videos.caption: Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Memo is a wheeled home robot from Sunday Robotics, a Mountain View startup founded by Stanford PhDs Tony Zhao and Cheng Chi. Unveiled in November 2025, it’s built to handle real household chores like loading the dishwasher, clearing tables, folding laundry, and even making espresso. Standing about 5'7" and weighing 170 lbs, Memo moves on a stable wheeled base and uses a telescoping spine to reach up to 6'10". Instead of human-like hands, it has dual grippers designed for strength and precision, wrapped in a soft silicone shell to stay safe around kids, pets, and furniture. It runs for about 4 hours per charge, can recharge to 80% in an hour, and travels at up to 1 m/s. Memo is powered by the ACT-1 foundation model, trained not on lab robots but on 10 million episodes of humans doing chores, captured with low-cost Skill Capture Gloves in over 500 homes. As a result, it can complete long, multi-step tasks—like a 33-step table-to-dishwasher routine—and generalize to new kitchens without teleoperation. Sunday is launching a 2026 beta with “Founding Families,” pitching Memo as a customizable, safe, skill-learning home appliance for single-floor homes.#Techtok #robotics #ainews #autonomous #futuretech

Ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in ¾” inch pieces 1/2 cup finely chopped onion 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 3/4 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin 1 cup green enchilada sauce or tomatillo salsa, divided 1 can pinto beans, drained 2 tablespoons melted butter 8 6-inch flour tortillas 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese 1/2 cup sour cream Shredded lettuce and any other desired toppings Directions: Preheat oven to 375. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken pieces well with garlic powder, salt, pepper, chili powder and cumin. Add chicken to hot skillet and cook, undisturbed until browned and easily releases from the pan, 3-4 minutes. Add onion and stir chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, 3 more minutes. Add 2/3 cup salsa and beans and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat slightly and cook, stirring occasionally until slightly thickened and creamy, about 5 minutes. Brush sides and bottom of an 11 x 7 baking pan or baking dish with butter. Working with 1 tortilla at a time, use remaining butter to brush one side of each tortilla and place in dish. Place about 1 tablespoons of cheese in bottom of the tortilla and top with about 1/3 cup filling and a couple more tablespoons of cheese. Fold tortilla up like a taco and place it against the edge of the pan. Place a second buttered tortilla against the next one and top with cheese and filling. Fold in half and repeat with remaining tortillas, filling and cheese to fill the baking dish with side by side tacos. Top with any remaining cheese. Bake 20-25 minutes or until tops of each tortilla are golden brown and toasted and cheese is melted and bubbly. Meanwhile, stir together remaining salsa with sour cream until well combined. Top with lettuce just before serving and serve topped with sour cream sauce. ✨ Recipe Inspiration: @iramsfoodstory 🎥: Nicole @nicolesperfectbite #chicken #tacos #baking #dinner

AI video editor in Claude Code: 3 prompts, from an empty folder to a finished reel. SETUP (once) 1. Get the Claude app (claude.ai/download) and open the Code tab, not the browser. 2. Make a folder "AI Editor" with 3 folders inside: raw, references, done. 3. New chat in Code → Local → Select folder → AI Editor. Needs a paid Claude plan. PROMPT 1: TOOLS You're my video editor. We work in this folder: raw, references, done. Install and verify 5 tools: FFmpeg with libass (on Mac: ffmpeg-full, full path), faster-whisper for word-level subtitles, yt-dlp for references, Remotion, HyperFrames (npm package hyperframes). Check what's installed first. Official installs only (Homebrew, winget, npm/pip), Node.js 22+. Python packages go in a .venv here, Python 3.14 or older: pip install faster-whisper "av<19". Test each for real: burn a subtitle into a test clip, transcribe 5 seconds of audio. Show a table: tool, version, works or not. PROMPT 2: YOUR TASTE Here are reels whose editing I like: [link 1] [link 2] [link 3]. My format: [talking to camera / voiceover]. Download them with yt-dlp into references (for study only). Study each one frame by frame and by ear: pacing, shot length, pause cuts, subtitles, colors, graphics, transitions, music, the first 3 seconds. Take inspiration, but don't copy: no shots, text, logos or brand elements. Write my own style to style.md with exact values. Show it and ask what to change. PROMPT 3: EDIT My new recording is in raw. Edit it using style.md: 1. Transcribe with Whisper, word timestamps. Ask me about doubtful words before burning subtitles. 2. Cut pauses, slips and bad takes, keep the last good take. Check cut points by audio level. Keep pauses that serve the meaning, breaths and word endings. Don't speed up my voice. 3. Word-by-word subtitles in my style. 4. If references/music.mp3 exists, put it quietly under the voice. 5. Graphics only where they help. 6. Export 1080×1920 to done as draft-v1.mp4 plus edit-notes.md. Check the file yourself, then show me. I'll give edits in plain words; save each as draft-v2, draft-v3. No code words. Follow for my own editing style, coming next.

There are so many good recipes out there, but truthfully I’ve always had a hard time finding one that actually works for the season of life I’m in. My husband works late and I have two little girls, so weeknight dinner is on me, and most nights I just don’t have the time, the energy, or the headspace for a lot of recipes. That’s pretty much why I started making my own dinners, and I hope other moms, or honestly anyone, can appreciate them, because to me they’re actually so easy. DUMB DINNERS Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo INGREDIENTS 1 box (16 oz) orzo, uncooked 1 tub (32 oz) Panera broccoli cheddar soup 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 3 cups shredded rotisserie chicken 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper a few shakes Frank’s RedHot 1 bag (12 oz) frozen broccoli florets 1 bag (8 oz) shredded extra-sharp cheddar a big handful Cheez-Its, crushed HOW TO MAKE IT Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9×13 dish. Dump in the orzo, soup, broth, and chicken. Sprinkle on the garlic powder, pepper, and hot sauce. Dump in the frozen broccoli straight from the bag. Stir well so the orzo is under the liquid. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes. Uncover and stir. It should look loose and creamy. Stir in half the cheddar. Top with the rest, then the crushed Cheez-Its. Bake uncovered 5 more minutes. Let it sit 10 minutes before serving. Taste before adding any salt. #creatorsearchinsights #easydinnerideas #easyrecipe #easymeal #dinnerideas

Mexican Food! Mexican Food! For the meat, boil 2lbs of chicken breast with 3 bay leaves, half an onion, salt, 3 cloves of garlic, and fresh ground pepper! Let them cook until they reach 165 degrees internal temperature. Remove them and let them cool for a bit, then shred them! For the sauce, in the same pot that you boiled your chicken breast, add 2 medium Roma tomatoes, and remove them once the skin breaks. When the chicken is done, transfer the garlic, onion, and tomatoes to your blender! Add 1 tsp of “better than bouillon”, 2 cups of the water you boiled your chicken in, 1 can of chipotle peppers, salt, pepper, and a pinch of oregano. Blend till it's smooth!  In a frying pan add some zero cal cooking spray and half an onion thinly sliced! Once the onion is softened toss in your shredded chicken breast and your sauce. Stir it until the chicken is completely covered in sauce, bring it to a simmer, cover your pan and let it sit off heat for around 10min!  To portion it, weigh out the tinga once it's all cooked and divide that by 5 to get 5 even portions! Mine weighed 48oz so that came out to 5 portions each weighing 9.6oz. For the chips, cut up 4 mission low-carb tortillas into triangles spray them with zero-cal cooking spray and air fry till they are crispy. Usually takes around 3-4min per side at 400 degrees! Ingredients  2lbs chicken breast 3 bay leaves  3cloves of garlic 1 onion 1 can chipotle peppers  Pinch of oregano  2 Roma tomatoes  1tsp “better than bouillon” 4 mission low carb tortillas  Fage 0% greek yogurt  Cotija cheese  Lettuce  Macros for 1 serving of tinga 1oz queso cotija 30g of greek yogurt and 4 low carb tortillas  390 Calories  53g Protein  24g Carbs 9g Fat . #diet #dieta #bajardepeso #weightloss #weightlosstransformation #weightlosscheck #mexican #mexicana #latinos #motivation #healthy #healthyrecipes #healthylifestyle #healthyliving #gym #protein #food #metas #saludable #chicken #mealprep #gym

People are wasting their time building AI agents. A model on its own needs context to be useful: prompts and instructions, tools it can call, and data it can trust. The old way was to write code that wires those three to the model, call it agent one, and do it again for every workflow. Harnesses like Claude Code and Codex already let an AI read and write your files, so you can put your prompts, tools and data in folders and let one AI become whatever agent your question needs. If you want something to study for the next ten years, I'd pick the Unix philosophy, Douglas Engelbart's 1962 report Augmenting Human Intellect, and plain old software logic. The long version, Do You Actually Need AI Agents?, is on my YouTube. Link in my bio. youtube.com/@JEVanClief #ai #aiagents #claudecode

High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers!!!  Tender chicken coated in a honey garlic soy sauce with sautéed peppers. Sticky, savory, and perfect over rice!!!  Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers  2 large chicken breast  Neutral oil  1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp soy 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp cornstarch  Sauce  Bell peppers, sliced (for sautéing) 1 tsp ginger paste or grated  2 tbsp garlic paste  2 tbsp honey  1/4 cup light and dark soy combined  1 tsp rice seasoning  1 tbsp hoisin sauce  1/2 tbsp oyster sauce  1/2 tsp Totole Granulated Chicken Flavor Season the chicken with neutral oil, seasonings, and cornstarch. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Cook the chicken in a skillet 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the sliced peppers until they reach your desired texture, then add the garlic paste. Pour in the sauce and simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add a 1:1 cornstarch slurry to thicken. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together until coated. This isn't a scene from a film. This is a heartbreaking reality that still exists in parts of Nepal. For some women and girls, getting their period means being sent away from their own home to spend the night in a small shed, away from their families. They are left to face cold nights, fear, loneliness, and the danger of snakes, insects, and wild animals—all because of a natural biological process. Menstruation should never be a reason for exclusion or shame. Take a moment and ask yourself: If it were someone you love—your daughter, your sister, your wife, or your mother—would you accept this as "tradition"? Some customs deserve to be questioned, especially when they put lives and dignity at risk. Every woman deserves to feel safe, respected, and valued, no matter what day of the month it is. Let's raise awareness, start conversations, and stand together to end harmful practices like this. EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

What I cooked my kids for dinner Episode 8 Chicken breaded au poivre🍗 Preheat oven to 400 degrees  Clean and dry 4 chicken breasts  Chop 1 shallot, 3 garlic cloves, 3 tbsp of rosemary Preheat stainless pan or cast iron on medium-medium high heat Season chicken generously with cracked black pepper and salt Leiden frost test pan if using stainless steel  Add avocado oil to pan once heated Add chicken breast seasoned side down Season other side with black pepper and salt Brown chicken only a few minutes until it develops color then set aside until all chicken is done Add all chicken back into pan along with chopped ingredients  Add about 3/4 carton of heavy cream or enough to almost cover the chicken breast  Bake in 400 degree oven for 40-50 minutes  Baste halfway through  Broil for 7 minutes (optional) Let breast and sauce cool so sauce can thicken Slice breast and server over mashed potatoes with au poivre sauce  Enjoy. #aupoivre #chickenbreast #recipe #cooking #whaticookedmykidsfordinner

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Rolls 🌯🧄🔥 Creamy garlic parmesan chicken, sautéed peppers and melted mozzarella, stuffed inside tortilla wraps and pan toasted until golden and crispy. 🤤 Recipe (Makes 3 Rolls) Ingredients: * ﻿﻿300g boiled chicken, shredded * ﻿﻿1 small onion, finely chopped * ﻿﻿¾ bell pepper, diced * ﻿﻿3 garlic cloves, crushed * ﻿﻿⅓ tsp salt (adjust to taste) * ﻿﻿¾ tsp paprika * ﻿﻿⅓ tsp black pepper * ﻿﻿⅓ tsp red chilli flakes * ﻿﻿¾ tsp chicken seasoning powder * ﻿﻿110ml fresh cream * ﻿﻿30g parmesan cheese, grated * ﻿﻿¾ tsp dried parsley * ﻿﻿3 large tortilla wraps * ﻿﻿90g mozzare la cheese, grated * ﻿﻿1½ tbsp oil for cooking Method: * ﻿﻿﻿Sauté onion, bell pepper and crushed garlic in a little oil until softened. * ﻿﻿﻿Add boiled chicken, salt, paprika, black pepper, chilli flakes and chicken seasoning. Mix well. * ﻿﻿﻿Stir in fresh cream, parmesan and dried parsley. Cook for a tew minutes until creamy, then allow to cool. * ﻿﻿﻿Divide the filling between 3 tortilla wraps, add mozzarella and fold tightly into rolls. * ﻿﻿﻿Heat a little oil in a pan and cook until golden and crispy on both sides. * ﻿﻿﻿Serve hot with crispy fries and enjoy! These homemade cheesy chicken wraps are seriously worth making, especially with a side of crispy fries! ¿Planeando una escapada a Marrakech? ¡Guarda este post porque lo vas a necesitar! 📌 Si tienes pensado visitar Marruecos pronto, te prometo que estas 5 actividades van a hacer que tu viaje pase de ser "muy chulo" a ser INOLVIDABLE. ✨ Aquí te dejo el resumen de mi top definitivo para que lo tengas a mano: 🎬 5. Ait Ben Haddou: Una excursión obligatoria. Pasear por esta ciudad de barro amurallada es sentirte dentro de Gladiator o Juego de Tronos. ¡Súper fotogénico! 🕌 4. Perderte con un guía local: La Medina es un laberinto increíble. Ir con alguien de allí es la mejor forma de empaparte de su cultura y descubrir joyas como el Palacio de la Bahía. 🎈 3. Ragi Roti and Glucose Spike 📉📈 Is Ragi actually the "magical healthy alternative" we all think it is? We put it to the ultimate Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) test, and the results were absolutely shocking. 🤯 Yesterday, regular wheat (aata) roti gave us a massive spike, leaving us super stressed. So, we tested the exact same weight of Ragi roti today, expecting much safer numbers. We waited a few hours, checked the monitor, and... trust me, you are not ready for this. My spike was a complete record-breaker—it matched the exact same spike I got from drinking straight pineapple juice!  And my mom's graph? It shot up even higher than the regular wheat roti! 📈 My mom used to have diabetes, but she brought it completely under control two years ago by giving up all types of roti. This test proved exactly why. I even pulled out the packets to compare the nutrition labels, and the truth about Ragi's fiber and net carbs compared to regular wheat will surprise you. The numbers don't lie. Watch the video to see the real-time graph and the final numbers! If you are looking for truly healthy, low-spike alternatives, check out my page for recipes like my Tofu Scramble, Gajar Ka Halwa, and Chocolate Pudding. ✅ Next up: We are testing Bajra ki Roti. Five plants that separate a designed garden from a planted one. Rosemary — most people treat it as a herb. Designers use it as a structural evergreen with silver foliage, late winter bloom, and serious drought tolerance once established. Echinops — steel-blue globe thistle that holds its form into winter. Pollinators love it, it seeds around just enough, and nothing else gives you that texture. White Cloud Nepeta — all the soft billowing habit of catmint, none of the blue. Cleaner in a white or silver palette. Underused because most people don’t know it exists. Mountain Hydrangea (Hydrangea serrata) — more refined than arborescens, lacecap form, better fall color, and it actually performs in part shade without flopping. Blue Mist Fothergilla (Fothergilla gardenii ‘Blue Mist’) — blue-green foliage all season, then flame in fall. Native, compact, and genuinely beautiful. The plant that makes clients ask “what is that?” #gardendesign #landscapedesign

Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. Save this one for later! 🤎 #BakedChicken #AffordableMeals #DinnerIdeas #ComfortFood #EasyRecipes

В переносном смысле слово означает бесцветный, будничный, неприметный, а также необразованный или неофициальный. [1] Физические и цветовые свойства * Ахроматичность: у цвета нет яркого цветового тона, он находится между белым и чёрным. *  * Оттенки: от светлого серебристого до тёмного графитового и мокрого асфальта. *  * Восприятие: успокаивает нервную систему и служит отличным фоном для других ярких цветов.[1, 2, 3, 4] *  Переносные и разговорные значения     * Тусклый и пасмурный: погода, день или сумерки без солнца. *  * Бесцветный и безликий: скучные будни, рутина или ничем не примечательный человек («серая масса»). *  * Малокультурный: непросвещённый или невежественный человек. *  * Неофициальный («серый» рынок, «серая» зарплата): находящийся в тени закона. Каждый цвет имеет свою длину волны (например, красный — длинные волны, синий — короткие). * Физиология: В сетчатке глаза человека есть рецепторы — колбочки, которые считывают информацию и передают сигналы в мозг. * Психология: Цвет вызывает эмоции, влияет на настроение и ассоциации, активно используется в дизайне. Cross posting to 4 accounts has been a little crazy and ya girl needs a breather 😮‍💨 so enjoy! ☺️  ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 If comfort food had a personality, this would be it. Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

5 things to know before going to Marrakech👇🇲🇦 1️⃣ Moroccan taxis WILL overcharge you, download @inDrive before you arrive. It works at the airport, you set your own price, so there’s no negotiation needed 🚖  2️⃣ Be aware of the animal abuse at Jemaa el-Fnaa. Men walk the square with monkeys in chains and snakes with their teeth removed, don’t pay if they confront you 🙊  3️⃣ Where you stay matters. I found my riad on the @cozycozy app, which compared the prices across all the major booking sites. Agoda was £40 vs £45 on Booking.com, saving £35 over 7 nights 🏨  4️⃣ Eat all the street food. Vendors need licences, so it’s clean, fresh and cheap. I reccoemnd trying this sardine salad just off the main square, search “fried fish” on google maps 🍗  5️⃣ Stay safe in the medina. Wear your backpack on your front, watch out for pickpockets, ignore the men on street corners and download offline maps before you arrive 🎒  Save this video for your trip to Morocco 📌 #marrakech #morocco #jemaaelfna #cozycozy #ad
